event_name: Country A's central bank policy rate is at or below 9% on 31 December 2026
event_description: The central bank of Country A's benchmark policy rate is 9.00% or lower on 31 December 2026. Only the headline policy rate counts; interbank, lending or deposit rates do not.
article_text:
The central bank of Country A has kept its benchmark interest rate at 8.75 percent, saying the current setting remains appropriate.
The rate-setting committee retained the policy rate at 8.75 percent at its meeting on Tuesday, with inflation still inside the target band.
The committee said it saw no immediate need to move in either direction.

event_name: Country B's central bank policy rate is at or below 9% on 31 December 2026
event_description: The central bank of Country B's benchmark policy rate is 9.00% or lower on 31 December 2026. Only the headline policy rate counts; interbank, lending or deposit rates do not.
article_text:
The central bank of Country B raised its benchmark interest rate to 9.5 percent on Tuesday, its second increase this year.
The rate-setting committee lifted the policy rate by 50 basis points, citing inflation that has run above target for six consecutive months.
The committee signalled that further tightening could not be ruled out before the end of the year.

event_name: Party P wins more than 33 seats at the next legislative election
event_description: Party P is allocated 34 or more seats in the final official result of the next legislative election. Projections and polls are evidence, not resolution.
article_text:
A poll published on Monday projects Party P winning 36 seats in the next legislative election.
The survey of 1,200 voters puts the party comfortably ahead of its nearest rival, which is projected at 24 seats.
Turnout assumptions are unchanged from the previous wave.

event_name: Party Q wins more than 33 seats at the next legislative election
event_description: Party Q is allocated 34 or more seats in the final official result of the next legislative election. Projections and polls are evidence, not resolution.
article_text:
A poll published on Monday projects Party Q winning 31 seats in the next legislative election.
The survey of 1,200 voters shows the party holding a narrow lead over its nearest rival, projected at 27 seats.
Turnout assumptions are unchanged from the previous wave.

event_name: Country C's annual inflation rate is between 2% and 3% in the final reading for 2026
event_description: Country C's headline annual consumer-price inflation is at least 2.0% and at most 3.0% in the final published reading for calendar 2026. Core inflation does not count.
article_text:
Annual consumer-price inflation in Country C came in at 2.4 percent in July, the statistics office said on Friday.
The reading was unchanged from June and remains inside the central bank's stated comfort range.
Food and energy prices were the main contributors to the monthly move.

event_name: Country D's annual inflation rate is between 2% and 3% in the final reading for 2026
event_description: Country D's headline annual consumer-price inflation is at least 2.0% and at most 3.0% in the final published reading for calendar 2026. Core inflation does not count.
article_text:
Annual consumer-price inflation in Country D accelerated to 4.1 percent in July, the statistics office said on Friday.
The reading was up from 3.6 percent in June and is the fastest pace recorded in more than two years.
Economists said the increase was broad-based rather than driven by a single category.

event_name: Party R wins more than 33 seats at the next legislative election
event_description: Party R is allocated 34 or more seats in the final official result of the next legislative election. Projections and polls are evidence, not resolution.
article_text:
Party R surged to its strongest showing in a decade, according to a poll published on Tuesday, in what its leader called a historic breakthrough.
The survey projects the party at 30 seats, up sharply from the 19 it holds today, and supporters celebrated outside the party's headquarters late into the evening.
Analysts described the result as a remarkable turnaround for a party written off two years ago.

event_name: Candidate S finishes with at least 30% of the vote in the first round
event_description: Candidate S receives 30.0% or more of valid votes cast in the first round. Polls and projections are evidence, not resolution.
article_text:
Support for Candidate S has collapsed to just 35 percent, a new poll showed on Tuesday, the campaign's worst result since it began and a humiliating fall from the 52 percent recorded in the spring.
Advisers privately described the numbers as devastating and conceded the campaign had lost control of the agenda.
The survey of 1,500 voters was conducted over three days last week.

event_name: Country E's central bank policy rate is at or below 9% on 31 December 2026
event_description: The central bank of Country E's benchmark policy rate is 9.00% or lower on 31 December 2026. Only the headline policy rate counts.
article_text:
The central bank of Country E trimmed its benchmark rate to 8.99 percent on Wednesday, an unusually fine adjustment the committee said was intended to signal caution rather than a change of direction.
The policy rate had stood at 9.10 percent since March.
The committee gave no guidance on its next move.

event_name: Country F's central bank policy rate is at or below 9% on 31 December 2026
event_description: The central bank of Country F's benchmark policy rate is 9.00% or lower on 31 December 2026 — a rate of exactly 9.00% satisfies the claim. Only the headline policy rate counts.
article_text:
The central bank of Country F cut its benchmark rate to exactly 9.00 percent on Wednesday, down from 9.25 percent.
The committee said the move completed the adjustment it had signalled at its previous meeting.
No further changes were flagged for the remainder of the year.
